detail: Keystone Realtors Limited submitted a disclosure document to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The PDF filing (accessed via NSE archive) confirms the regulatory filing but the acquirer identity, shareholding percentage, and consideration are not disclosed in the headline. This is a mandatory disclosure step for any party acquiring shares beyond the 25% threshold (or in certain slabs), and typically precedes either an open offer or an exemption order from SEBI.
